content: Admission Inquiry Academics Krishna School of Science KPGU's Faculty of Science offers UGC-recognized B.Sc. Honours, B.Sc. Honours with Research and M.Sc. programs in Biotechnology, Chemistry, Physics, Microbiology, and Mathematics in Vadodara - building research-ready graduates for careers in science, pharma, and the life sciences industry. 0 Constituent School 3 Departments 5 Programs Offered 9+ Faculty Members WELCOME Message from the Director Dr.Rita Mahapatra Director, KSS (Faculty of Science) Krishna School of Science (KSS) at Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara, is built on a single conviction - science drives societal progress. As one of Gujarat's emerging centers of science education and research, KSS prepares graduates who are ready to contribute meaningfully to the scientific world across biotechnology, chemistry, physics, and beyond. Our academic environment is designed to move beyond the classroom. Students engage with advanced laboratories, live research projects, and direct exposure to industry and scientific institutions through expert seminars, workshops, and structured field visits. At KSS, learning is hands-on, inquiry-driven, and always current. We invest equally in intellectual and personal development - nurturing critical thinking, ethical values, leadership, and collaborative skills. Whether you aim for a career in research, pharma, academia, or entrepreneurship, KSS equips you with the rigour and mindset to thrive. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “To be a leading center of scientific education and research in Gujarat - nurturing curiosity, driving interdisciplinary innovation, and empowering graduates to create lasting societal impact.” Our Mission Deliver rigorous, research-integrated science education aligned with national and global academic standards Provide hands-on learning through advanced laboratories, funded research projects, and scientific workshops Strengthen student participation in research, innovation competitions, and academic seminars Foster ethical values, critical thinking, and leadership for well-rounded graduate development Build meaningful partnerships with industry, research institutions, and society for real-world exposure FOCUS AREAS Academic Departments 01 Biotechnology Explore → 02 Chemistry Explore → 03 Mathematics Explore → 04 Microbiology Explore → 05 Physics Explore → ACADEMICS Programs & Duration Program Name Level Duration B.Sc.
